briefings.title: Thomas Laffont: The $4T AI IPO Wave Is Coming… and We’ve Never Seen Anything Like It
briefings.tldr: Coatue’s Thomas Laffont outlines an impending $4 trillion AI-driven IPO wave led by the "Magnificent Eight" (including SpaceX, OpenAI, and Anthropic), driven by unprecedented software scaling and a stark power-law dynamic where the largest "centicorn" companies are compounding faster than ever before.
